property_summary: After calling setOwner, the owner remains unchanged (equal to the original deployer) because the modifier always reverts.
After calling setOwner(address), the owner is always the msg.sender who performed the call.
After calling setOwner with any address, the owner state must be equal to the address passed as argument.
After calling setOwner with any address, the owner state must equal the address passed as argument.
After calling setOwner, the owner remains the original deployer, but the buggy modifier always reverts, so the call never changes owner.
